newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki corrects lower, financial sector in focus.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki corrects lower, financial sector in focus.

text.p: Shares ended mixed on Monday with strength in the financial sector and forestries, but the HEX was dragged by weakness in Nokia and profit-taking in Huhtamaki which surged 18 percent of Friday, brokers said.
The HEX index ended down 0.24 percent at 2,254.00, with volume a hefty 583 million markka, inflated by a big trade from Swedish insurer Skandia in Pohjola.
Skandia swapped over a million liquid Pohjola B shares for a million vote-strong but illiquid Pohjola A shares, but later said it had no plans to increase its holding further.

However, that statement came after the close and during trade hopes were boosted Skandia would prompt further restructuring in the Nordic financial sector, lifting both Pohjola and Merita, brokers said.
Pohjola B closed off its 105.00 markka year-high at 101.00 markka, still up 2.00 and Pohjola A closed unchanged at 104.00, also after setting a year high at 106.00 markka.

Huhtamaki closed at 215, down 3.00, but traded at a 210.00 markka low as investors took profits from its sharp gains on Friday after it said it would swap its U.S. confectionery unit for Hershey's European one, getting 1.5 billion markka in cash.
